name: Rubens Glew
original_name: ルーベンス・グリュー
source: The current King who is respected by everyone for his generosity and admirable character. He loves his wife Sofia very much but due to the pressure from surrounding about not having a successor even after 15 years of marriage, he unwillingly accepts a new concubine while holding guilty feeling for his beloved wife.
translation: The current King who is respected by everyone for his generosity and admirable character.
